result:
All done. Both fixes are verified by the suite (9/9 passing: "all tests passed"), the refactor keeps every flag (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-q/--quiet`, `-h/--help`, `=`-forms, `--`, unknown-option exit 1) working identically, and `backup.sh`/`restore.sh`/`report.sh` are untouched.

- `rotate.sh` — surplus is now `head -n (total - keep)` (the oldest archives) with an early exit at `total <= keep`, so exactly N archives are all kept and the newest is never deleted.
- `verify.sh` — sidecar lines are split with `read -r expected file` (digest + rest-of-line) and the comparison is quoted, so names with spaces verify as `ok`.
- `lib/common.sh` — new; holds the shared option parser (`parse_common_options`), `is_uint`, `need_value`, and `resolve_dir`, sourced by both scripts.
- `tests/run_tests.sh` — one new test per bug, next to the existing tests (plus a companion check that rotation deletes the oldest when there is surplus).

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and new `lib/common.sh`.
